variety_description: A good yielding, medium maturity, semi-dwarf, long-bold grain variety extensively grown in Bihar under irrigated mid to low land conditions. Developed by IGKVV, Raipur and released in 1994. Good grain quality. Preferred for making flaked (poha) and puffed (murmura) products. High HRR and heavy grains. Tolerant to lodging and major diseases and insect pests.
